lattice.model: zigzag AQH (Haldane-type) coupled-ring lattice, LLE per ring
lattice.units: kappa_in = kappa/2 = 1; time in 2/kappa (lifetimes); Delta = (2/kappa)(omega_res - omega_pump), Delta > 0 is RED (opposite sign to the Topological Photonics Explorer convention)
lattice.equation: dA_r/dt = [-(1 + i Delta) - i d2 mu^2] A_r,mu - i sum_r' H_rr' A_r',mu - kappa_ex,r A_r,mu + i FT[|psi_r|^2 psi_r]_mu + F_r delta_mu,0
lattice.drive: single CW tone on ring 0, F0 = sqrt(F0_squared), placed so that the pumped edge supermode sits at Delta_eff (solver Delta = Delta_eff - lambda_sigma)

linear_P500_D1.00.description: Below threshold: linear tilted resonance, no comb. Reference state.

turing14_P2500_D0.10.description: Turing roll at the modulational-instability onset: 14 equidistant phi-pulses in every boundary ring, the same positions in every ring (k=0), stationary (power drift 5e-7 over 20 lt, no drift in phi), 99% of the comb on the harmonics of 14 (mu = +-14, +-28). Cold start from noise, locked after ~250 lt.
turing14_P2500_D0.10.source: cold start from noise at these parameters, held 400 lt (scratch run roll_hold.py, 2026-10-07)

chaos_P3500_D3.10.description: Developed MI chaos: power wanders, fine spectra filled.

minicomb_P3500_D1.40.description: Locked mini-comb candidate inside the dynamic zone: discrete equidistant fine lines in tooth mu=4 under a smooth envelope. Nesting NOT established.

cw_P3500_D4.80.description: CW lower branch at the same point as turing3_P3500_D4.80 (cold start) — multistability.

turing3_P3500_D4.80.description: Three-soliton crystal (archive name turing3 is a misnomer): 3 bound phi-pulses at 0, 112 and 315 degrees, not equidistant, soliton-type spectrum; every boundary ring in phase (k=0).

soliton2_P3500_D4.90.description: Two stationary pulses per ring; power = CW + 2 x 3.6 (quantisation family).

soliton1_P3500_D4.90.description: HERO-1: single stationary soliton per boundary ring, k=0 along the edge (NOT nested). Prepared by pulse surgery on turing3; drift 1e-15 over 800 lifetimes.

chaos_P6500_D1.00.description: Chaos already owns the blue side at this pump (no Turing window here).

chaos_P6500_D4.50.description: Developed chaos just before the collapse at 5.2.

gas_P6500_D5.50.description: Dense edge soliton gas, metastable: evaporated one envelope at t ~ 250 lifetimes.

gas_P6500_D5.90.description: Edge soliton gas: ~9 pulses localised in both ring and phi, disordered.

crystal_P6500_D6.30.description: Nested soliton crystal: ~5 pulses, clean periodic sawtooth in the power, rigid 2D comb.

nested_soliton_P6500_D6.60.description: *** THE RESULT *** Single nested travelling edge soliton: ONE envelope localised in boundary-ring AND phi, circulating the 20-ring edge once every 0.56 lifetimes (35.7 rings/lt, chiral, one direction), rigid equidistant comb across all teeth. Verified 1100 lifetimes.

cw_P6500_D6.90.description: CW: one step red of the single soliton the shelf is over.
